image_description: A high-angle shot of a white rectangular plastic tub containing multiple live Dungeness crabs. The crabs are piled on top of each other, filling the bottom of the container. Their carapaces are visible, showing characteristic brownish-purple coloration with lighter mottling. Several legs and claws are visible protruding from the pile, though many are occluded by other crabs or the container walls.
